title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Heard you guys were well-represented watching Abrams’ yesterday

Same to you, happy opening day I’m glad you texted. I actually meant to write you yesterday. I enjoyed your end of ST column. That little twinge of melancholy...yeah Lakeland sucks but ST can be a lot of fun and I always had a bittersweet feeling at the end. I guess I identified with that...

Trammel wants to see some players in real games so I know they were doing a Georgia run, my crosschecker James Orr is up there with him. Haven’t talked to him yet for an update...not sure who else was there with them
Tram went to see Riley Greene with Leyland and DC a few weeks back. Know tram will grab some of the California guys at some point in the next 8 weeks too
